run_pipeline_z_image_differential_img2im: run the ZImageDifferentialImg2ImgPipeline to generate images from a prompt with an init image and mask using differential diffusion
create_z_image_differential_pipeline: create a ZImageDifferentialImg2ImgPipeline instance from a pretrained model with scheduler, vae, text_encoder, tokenizer, and transformer components
encode_text_prompts: encode text prompts into embeddings using the pipeline's tokenizer and text_encoder with optional negative prompts for classifier-free guidance
prepare_image_latents: prepare image latents by encoding an input image through the VAE and adding noise at a given timestep for diffusion
apply_differential_diffusion_mask: apply differential diffusion by blending denoised latents with masked original image latents across timesteps using a thresholded mask
